rules.description: COBOL program with high paragraph count indicates complex control flow
rules.detection_condition: component_type == 'MODULE' and technology == 'COBOL' and detected_properties.paragraph_count present and detected_properties.paragraph_count > 10
rules.explanation: A COBOL program with more than 10 paragraphs suggests intricate control flow that increases migration effort.
rules.recommendation: Review the program's paragraph structure and identify opportunities for modular refactoring before migration.

rules.recommendation: Catalog all GOTO targets and rewrite them as structured PERFORM or IF/ELSE blocks during refactoring.
